An off-diagonal orbit has exactly its two diagonal endpoints as neighbors, so each peripheral contractible piece meets the diagonal simplex in q/2 disjoint contractible edges. Every attaching inclusion factors through that diagonal simplex, giving q/2-1 new circles per h via homotopy pushout.
